brief:
Ed Sheeran removed rapper Macklemore from his tour after pressure from the musician over Macklemore's pro-Palestine stance, The Guardian reported. The move contradicted Sheeran's earlier embrace of the politically outspoken artist, transforming what had been positioned as a collaborative moment into a public dispute over the tour's political alignment.

The controversy marks a reckoning for Sheeran's carefully cultivated "Mr Nice Guy" image in the music industry. Macklemore's removal has intensified debate over the tour's values and the influence of major artists in shaping which political voices receive platforms.
dek: Moment of reckoning for ‘Mr Nice Guy’ of music, who embraced Macklemore’s political cred only for pro-Palestine rapper to be dropped under pressure from billionaire Ed Sheeran has long been known as the “Mr Nice Guy” of music.
title: Ed Sheeran drops Macklemore from tour amid Palestine controversy
